entities.name: Avohir
entities.description: A god worshipped in the kingdom of Efuan Pincar in northern Gulmany; myths say his home was in the sea.

entities.name: Efuan Pincar
entities.description: Kingdom in northern Gulmany settled after the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Gulmany
entities.description: Land in the Terisian Isles on Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the Terisian Isles.

entities.name: Efuands
entities.description: People of Efuan Pincar who worship Avohir.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Flood that melted the Ronom Glacier, revealing the northern shore of Gulmany.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Glacier melted by the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Nation from which settlers sailed to found Efuan Pincar; famously agnostic.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: A follower of Avohir who often invoked his name.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Destroyed the sleeper agents of Gulmany and made a golden dragon to rescue the holy book and king.

entities.name: Tabarna
entities.description: The Efuand king rescued by Urza's golden dragon.

events.summary: After the Flooding of Terisiare reveals the northern shore of Gulmany, boats carrying 300 people from Argive settle Efuan Pincar.
events.quote: boats carrying 300 people from Argive came to the shores and settled the land

events.summary: Worship of Avohir spreads across the whole kingdom, with temples or shrines in every city and village.
events.quote: the worship of Avohir had spread to the whole kingdom

events.summary: After destroying Gulmany's sleeper agents, Urza makes a golden dragon to rescue Avohir's holy book and King Tabarna, flying them out to sea.
events.quote: he took the opportunity to make a great golden dragon, shimmering and semi-transparent, to rescue the holy book of Avohir and the Efuand king Tabarna

relations.note: Follower who invoked his name often
relations.quote: Ratepe was a follower of Avohir's religion, and invoked Avohir's name often.
to rescue the holy book of Avohir and the Efuand king Tabarna
